          result = await this.processWithTimeout(claimedPayment);
        } catch (error) {
          this.logger?.warn(
            {
              event: 'payment_gateway_error',
              paymentId: claimedPayment.id,
              attemptCount: claimedPayment.attemptCount,
              failureCode:
                error instanceof GatewayAttemptTimeoutError
                  ? 'processing_timeout'
                  : 'processing_error',
            },
            'Payment gateway attempt failed',
          );
          await this.retryOrFail(
            claimedPayment,
            error instanceof GatewayAttemptTimeoutError
              ? 'processing_timeout'
              : 'attempts_exhausted',
          );
          return true;
        }
    
        if (result.kind === 'succeeded') {
          await this.completePayment(claimedPayment, 'succeeded');
        } else if (result.retryable) {
          await this.retryOrFail(claimedPayment, result.failureCode);
        } else {
          await this.completePayment(claimedPayment, 'failed', result.failureCode);
        }
    
        return true;
      }
    
      private async processWithTimeout(
        payment: Payment,
      ): Promise<PaymentGatewayResult> {
        const abortController = new AbortController();
        this.activeAttemptController = abortController;
        let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        const timeoutResult = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
          timeout = setTimeout(() => {
            abortController.abort();
            reject(new GatewayAttemptTimeoutError(this.options.attemptTimeoutMs));
          }, this.options.attemptTimeoutMs);
          timeout.unref();
        });
    
        try {
          return await Promise.race([
            this.gateway.processPayment(payment, {
              idempotencyKey: payment.id,
              signal: abortController.signal,
            }),
            timeoutResult,
          ]);
        } finally {
          if (timeout !== undefined) {
            clearTimeout(timeout);
          }
    
          if (this.activeAttemptController === abortController) {
            this.activeAttemptController = undefined;
          }
        }
      }
    
      private async retryOrFail(
        payment: Payment,
        terminalFailureCode: PaymentFailureCode,
      ): Promise<void> {
        if (payment.attemptCount >= this.options.maxAttempts) {
          await this.completePayment(payment, 'failed', terminalFailureCode);
          return;
        }
    
        assertPaymentTransitionAllowed({
          actor: 'worker',
          from: payment.status,
          to: 'pending',
        });
        const timestamp = this.clock.now();
        const retryPayment: Payment = {
          id: payment.id,
          amount: payment.amount,
          currency: payment.currency,
          ...(payment.reference === undefined
            ? {}
            : { reference: payment.reference }),
          status: 'pending',
          attemptCount: payment.attemptCount,
          nextAttemptAt: new Date(
            timestamp.getTime() + this.retryDelayMs(payment.attemptCount),
          ).toISOString(),
          createdAt: payment.createdAt,
          updatedAt: timestamp.toISOString(),
          version: payment.version + 1,
        };
    
        await this.persistOutcome(payment, retryPayment, 'payment_retry_scheduled');
      }
    
      private async completePayment(
        payment: Payment,
        status: 'succeeded' | 'failed',
        failureCode?: PaymentFailureCode,
      ): Promise<void> {
        assertPaymentTransitionAllowed({
          actor: 'worker',
          from: payment.status,
          to: status,
        });
        const timestamp = this.clock.now().toISOString();
        const completedPayment: Payment = {
          id: payment.id,
          amount: payment.amount,
          currency: payment.currency,
          ...(payment.reference === undefined
            ? {}
            : { reference: payment.reference }),
          status,
          attemptCount: payment.attemptCount,
          ...(payment.processingStartedAt === undefined
            ? {}
            : { processingStartedAt: payment.processingStartedAt }),
          ...(status === 'failed' && failureCode !== undefined
            ? { failureCode }
            : {}),
          createdAt: payment.createdAt,
          updatedAt: timestamp,
          version: payment.version + 1,
        };
    
        await this.persistOutcome(payment, completedPayment, 'payment_completed');
      }
    
      private async persistOutcome(
        claimed: Payment,
        next: Payment,
        event: string,
      ): Promise<void> {
        const fields = {
          paymentId: claimed.id,
          attemptCount: claimed.attemptCount,
          version: claimed.version,
          durationMs: Math.max(
            0,
            this.clock.now().getTime() -
              Date.parse(claimed.processingStartedAt ?? claimed.updatedAt),
          ),
        };
    
        try {
          const result = await this.repository.updatePayment(next, claimed.version);
          if (result.kind !== 'updated') {
            this.logger?.warn(
              {
                ...fields,
                event: 'payment_worker_result_discarded',
                reason: result.kind,
              },
              'Stale worker result discarded',
            );
            return;
          }
    
          this.logger?.info(
            {
              ...fields,
              event,
              status: next.status,
              version: next.version,
              nextAttemptAt: next.nextAttemptAt,
              failureCode: next.failureCode,
            },
            'Payment attempt outcome persisted',
          );
        } catch (error) {
          this.logger?.error(
            { ...fields, event: 'payment_persistence_failed', err: error },
            'Payment outcome persistence failed',
          );
          throw error;
        }
      }
    
      private retryDelayMs(attemptCount: number): number {
        const exponentialDelay =
          this.options.retryBaseDelayMs * 2 ** Math.max(0, attemptCount - 1);
        const maximumJitter = Math.floor(exponentialDelay * 0.2);
        const jitter = Math.floor(this.random() * (maximumJitter + 1));
        return exponentialDelay + jitter;
      }
    
      private schedulePoll(delayMs: number): void {
        this.pollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          this.pollTimer = undefined;
          const poll = this.runPoll();
          this.activePoll = poll;
          void poll.finally(() => {
            if (this.activePoll === poll) {
              this.activePoll = undefined;
            }
    
            if (this.running) {
              this.schedulePoll(this.options.pollIntervalMs);
            }
          });
        }, delayMs);
        this.pollTimer.unref();
      }
    
      private async runPoll(): Promise<void> {
        try {
          await this.processNextPayment();
        } catch (error) {
          this.reportError(error);
        }
      }
    }

    // Exercise the real Express stack over in-memory streams; no listening port is needed.
    export async function getTestResponse(app: Express, path: string) {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      const stream = new Duplex({
        read() {},
        write(chunk: Uint8Array | string, _encoding, callback) {
          chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk));
          callback();
        },
      });
      Object.assign(stream, { remoteAddress: '127.0.0.1' });
      const request = new IncomingMessage(stream as Socket);
      request.method = 'GET';
      request.url = path;
      request.headers = { host: 'localhost' };
      const response = new ServerResponse(request);
      response.assignSocket(stream as Socket);
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        response.once('finish', resolve);
        response.once('error', reject);
        app(request as Request, response as Response);
      });
      stream.destroy();
      const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
      const bodyOffset = raw.indexOf('\r\n\r\n') + 4;
      return {
        status: response.statusCode,
        headers: response.getHeaders(),
        body: raw.slice(bodyOffset),
      };
    }

    import type {
      CreatePaymentResult,
      UpdatePaymentResult,
    } from '../../modules/payments/payment-repository.types.js';
    import type {
      IdempotencyRecord,
      Payment,
    } from '../../modules/payments/payment.types.js';
    import {
      InvalidPaymentVersionError,
      RepositoryInvariantError,
    } from '../../modules/payments/payment-repository.errors.js';
    import { STORAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION } from './storage.const.js';
    import type { DocumentMutation, StorageDocument } from './storage.types.js';
    
    export class PaymentStorageState {
      private readonly document: StorageDocument;
    
      constructor(document?: StorageDocument) {
        this.document =
          document === undefined
            ? {
                schemaVersion: STORAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
                payments: {},
                idempotencyRecords: {},
              }
            : structuredClone(document);
      }
    
      toDocument(): StorageDocument {
        return structuredClone(this.document);
      }
    
      findPaymentById(id: string): Payment | undefined {
        const payment = this.document.payments[id];
        return payment === undefined ? undefined : this.clonePayment(payment);
      }
    
      findIdempotencyRecordByKey(key: string): IdempotencyRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.document.idempotencyRecords[key];
        return record === undefined
          ? undefined
          : this.cloneIdempotencyRecord(record);
      }
    
      private clonePayment(payment: Payment): Payment {
        return structuredClone(payment);
      }
    
      private cloneIdempotencyRecord(record: IdempotencyRecord): IdempotencyRecord {
        return structuredClone(record);
      }
    
      createPayment(
        payment: Payment,
        idempotencyRecord: IdempotencyRecord,
      ): DocumentMutation<CreatePaymentResult> {
        const document = this.document;
        if (idempotencyRecord.paymentId !== payment.id) {
          throw new RepositoryInvariantError(
            'Idempotency record paymentId must match the created payment id',
          );
        }
    
        const existingRecord = document.idempotencyRecords[idempotencyRecord.key];
    
        if (existingRecord !== undefined) {
          const existingPayment = document.payments[existingRecord.paymentId];
    
          if (existingPayment === undefined) {
            throw new RepositoryInvariantError(
              'Idempotency record references a missing payment',
            );
          }
    
          if (existingRecord.requestHash === idempotencyRecord.requestHash) {
            return {
              document,
              result: {
                kind: 'replayed',
                payment: this.clonePayment(existingPayment),
              },
            };
          }
    
          return {
            document,
            result: {
              kind: 'idempotency_conflict',
              existingPaymentId: existingRecord.paymentId,
            },
          };
        }
    
        if (document.payments[payment.id] !== undefined) {
          throw new RepositoryInvariantError(
            `Payment ${payment.id} already exists`,
          );
        }
    
        const storedPayment = this.clonePayment(payment);
        const storedRecord = this.cloneIdempotencyRecord(idempotencyRecord);
        const nextDocument: StorageDocument = {
          schemaVersion: STORAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
          payments: { ...document.payments, [payment.id]: storedPayment },
          idempotencyRecords: {
            ...document.idempotencyRecords,
            [idempotencyRecord.key]: storedRecord,
          },
        };
    
        return {
          document: nextDocument,
          result: { kind: 'created', payment: this.clonePayment(storedPayment) },
        };
      }
    
      updatePayment(
        payment: Payment,
        expectedVersion: number,
      ): DocumentMutation<UpdatePaymentResult> {
        const document = this.document;
        const currentPayment = document.payments[payment.id];
    
        if (currentPayment === undefined) {
          return { document, result: { kind: 'not_found' } };
        }
    
        if (currentPayment.version !== expectedVersion) {
          return {
            document,
            result: {
              kind: 'version_conflict',
              currentPayment: this.clonePayment(currentPayment),
            },
          };
        }
    
        if (payment.version !== expectedVersion + 1) {
          throw new InvalidPaymentVersionError(expectedVersion, payment.version);
        }
    
        const storedPayment = this.clonePayment(payment);
        const nextDocument: StorageDocument = {
          ...document,
          payments: { ...document.payments, [payment.id]: storedPayment },
        };
    
        return {
          document: nextDocument,
          result: { kind: 'updated', payment: this.clonePayment(storedPayment) },
        };
      }
    
      private isDue(payment: Payment, nowIso: string): boolean {
        return (
          payment.status === 'pending' &&
          (payment.nextAttemptAt === undefined || payment.nextAttemptAt <= nowIso)
        );
      }
    
      private dueOrder(payment: Payment): string {
        return payment.nextAttemptAt ?? payment.createdAt;
      }
    
      claimNextDuePayment(now: Date): DocumentMutation<Payment | undefined> {
        const document = this.document;
        const nowIso = now.toISOString();
        const payment = Object.values(document.payments)
          .filter((candidate) => this.isDue(candidate, nowIso))
          .toSorted((left, right) => {
            const timeOrder = this.dueOrder(left).localeCompare(
              this.dueOrder(right),

            return timeOrder === 0 ? left.id.localeCompare(right.id) : timeOrder;
          })[0];

        }

          result: recoveredCount,

      nextAttemptAt: timestampSchema.optional(),

      })

          if (id !== payment.id) {
            context.addIssue({
              code: 'custom',
              message: 'payment map key must match payment.id',
              path: ['payments', id],
            });
          }
        }
    
        for (const [key, record] of Object.entries(document.idempotencyRecords)) {
          if (key !== record.key) {
            context.addIssue({
              code: 'custom',
              message: 'idempotency map key must match record.key',
              path: ['idempotencyRecords', key],
            });
          }
    
          if (document.payments[record.paymentId] === undefined) {
            context.addIssue({
              code: 'custom',
              message: 'idempotency record must reference an existing payment',
              path: ['idempotencyRecords', key, 'paymentId'],
            });
          }
        }
      });

    }
    
    export function parseStorageDocument(contents: string): StorageDocument {
      let value: unknown;
    
      try {
        value = JSON.parse(contents) as unknown;

          cause: error,
        });
      }
    
      if (
        hasSchemaVersion(value) &&
        value.schemaVersion !== STORAGE_SCHEMA_VERSION
      ) {
        throw new UnsupportedStorageVersionError(value.schemaVersion);
      }
    
      const result = storageDocumentSchema.safeParse(value);
    
      if (!result.success) {
        throw new InvalidStorageDataError(
          `Storage data failed validation: ${z.prettifyError(result.error)}`,
          { cause: result.error },
        );
      }
    
      return result.data as StorageDocument;
    }

    export async function writeFileAtomically(
      filePath: string,
      contents: string,
    ): Promise<void> {
      const temporaryPath = join(
        dirname(filePath),
        `.${basename(filePath)}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`,
      );
    
      try {
        const handle = await open(temporaryPath, 'wx', 0o600);
    
        try {
          await handle.writeFile(contents, { encoding: 'utf8' });
          await handle.sync();
        } finally {
          await handle.close();
        }
    
        await rename(temporaryPath, filePath);
      } catch (error) {
        await rm(temporaryPath, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
      }
    }

    export class InMemoryPaymentRepository implements PaymentRepository {
      private readonly mutationQueue = new MutationQueue();
      private initialized = false;
      private state: PaymentStorageState;
    
      constructor(initialDocument?: StorageDocument) {
        this.state = new PaymentStorageState(initialDocument);
      }
    
      initialize(): Promise<void> {
        this.initialized = true;
        return Promise.resolve();
      }
    
      async createPayment(
        payment: Payment,
        idempotencyRecord: IdempotencyRecord,
      ): Promise<CreatePaymentResult> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          const mutation = this.state.createPayment(payment, idempotencyRecord);
          if (mutation.result.kind === 'created') {
            this.state = new PaymentStorageState(mutation.document);
          }
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      findPaymentById(id: string): Promise<Payment | undefined> {
        return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          return this.state.findPaymentById(id);
        });
      }
    
      findIdempotencyRecordByKey(
        key: string,
      ): Promise<IdempotencyRecord | undefined> {
        return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          return this.state.findIdempotencyRecordByKey(key);
        });
      }
    
      async updatePayment(
        payment: Payment,
        expectedVersion: number,
      ): Promise<UpdatePaymentResult> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          const mutation = this.state.updatePayment(payment, expectedVersion);
          if (mutation.result.kind === 'updated') {
            this.state = new PaymentStorageState(mutation.document);
          }
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      async claimNextDuePayment(now: Date): Promise<Payment | undefined> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          const mutation = this.state.claimNextDuePayment(now);
          if (mutation.result !== undefined) {
            this.state = new PaymentStorageState(mutation.document);
          }
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      async recoverExpiredPayments(now: Date, leaseMs: number): Promise<number> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(() => {
          this.assertInitialized();
          const mutation = this.state.recoverExpiredPayments(now, leaseMs);
          if (mutation.result > 0) {
            this.state = new PaymentStorageState(mutation.document);
          }
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      private assertInitialized(): void {
        if (!this.initialized) {
          throw new RepositoryNotInitializedError();
        }

    function isNodeError(error: unknown): error is NodeJS.ErrnoException {
      return error instanceof Error && 'code' in error;
    }
    
    export class JsonPaymentRepository implements PaymentRepository {
      private readonly filePath: string;
      private readonly mutationQueue = new MutationQueue();
      private readonly writeFileAtomically: AtomicFileWriter;
      private state: PaymentStorageState | undefined;
    
      constructor(options: JsonPaymentRepositoryOptions) {
        this.filePath = options.filePath;
        this.writeFileAtomically =
          options.writeFileAtomically ?? defaultAtomicWriter;
      }
    
      async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        await this.mutationQueue.run(async () => {
          if (this.state !== undefined) {
            return;
          }
    
          await mkdir(dirname(this.filePath), { recursive: true });
    
          try {
            const contents = await readFile(this.filePath, 'utf8');
            this.state = new PaymentStorageState(parseStorageDocument(contents));
          } catch (error) {
            if (!isNodeError(error) || error.code !== 'ENOENT') {
              throw error;
            }
    
            const initialState = new PaymentStorageState();
            const initialDocument = initialState.toDocument();
            await this.persist(initialDocument);
            this.state = initialState;
          }
        });
      }
    
      async createPayment(
        payment: Payment,
        idempotencyRecord: IdempotencyRecord,
      ): Promise<CreatePaymentResult> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(async () => {
          const mutation = this.getState().createPayment(
            payment,
            idempotencyRecord,
          );
    
          if (mutation.result.kind === 'created') {
            await this.persistAndPublish(mutation.document);
          }
    
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      findPaymentById(id: string): Promise<Payment | undefined> {
        return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          return this.getState().findPaymentById(id);
        });
      }
    
      findIdempotencyRecordByKey(
        key: string,
      ): Promise<IdempotencyRecord | undefined> {
        return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
          return this.getState().findIdempotencyRecordByKey(key);
        });
      }
    
      async updatePayment(
        payment: Payment,
        expectedVersion: number,
      ): Promise<UpdatePaymentResult> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(async () => {
          const mutation = this.getState().updatePayment(payment, expectedVersion);
    
          if (mutation.result.kind === 'updated') {
            await this.persistAndPublish(mutation.document);
          }
    
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      async claimNextDuePayment(now: Date): Promise<Payment | undefined> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(async () => {
          const mutation = this.getState().claimNextDuePayment(now);
    
          if (mutation.result !== undefined) {
            await this.persistAndPublish(mutation.document);
          }
    
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      async recoverExpiredPayments(now: Date, leaseMs: number): Promise<number> {
        return this.mutationQueue.run(async () => {
          const mutation = this.getState().recoverExpiredPayments(now, leaseMs);
    
          if (mutation.result > 0) {
            await this.persistAndPublish(mutation.document);
          }
    
          return mutation.result;
        });
      }
    
      private getState(): PaymentStorageState {
        if (this.state === undefined) {
          throw new RepositoryNotInitializedError();
        }
    
        return this.state;
      }
    
      private async persistAndPublish(document: StorageDocument): Promise<void> {
        await this.persist(document);
        this.state = new PaymentStorageState(document);
      }
    
      private async persist(document: StorageDocument): Promise<void> {
        const contents = `${JSON.stringify(document, null, 2)}\n`;
        parseStorageDocument(contents);
        await this.writeFileAtomically(this.filePath, contents);
      }
    }

    import type {
      PaymentGateway,
      PaymentGatewayResult,
    } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/payment-gateway.types.js';
    import { PaymentWorker } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/payment.worker.js';
    import { InMemoryPaymentRepository } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/repositories/in-memory-payment.repository.js';
    import type { Clock } from '../../../../src/shared/types/clock.types.js';

    import { ScriptedPaymentGateway } from '../../../helpers/scripted-payment-gateway.js';

    const defaultWorkerOptions = {
      attemptTimeoutMs: 1_000,
      maxAttempts: 3,
      pollIntervalMs: 250,
      retryBaseDelayMs: 250,
      shutdownTimeoutMs: 500,
    } as const;
    
    async function createSeededRepository(): Promise<InMemoryPaymentRepository> {
      const repository = new InMemoryPaymentRepository();
      await repository.initialize();
      await repository.createPayment(buildPayment(), buildIdempotencyRecord());
      return repository;
    }
    
    describe('PaymentWorker', () => {
      afterEach(() => {
        vi.useRealTimers();
      });
    
      it('claims and completes a successful payment', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'succeeded' }]);
        const clock: Clock = {
          now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z'),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          clock,
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          () => 0,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
    
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(true);
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'succeeded',
          attemptCount: 1,
          version: 3,
        });
        expect(gateway.contexts[0]?.idempotencyKey).toBe(buildPayment().id);
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_attempt_started',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 1,
            }),
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_completed',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 1,
              status: 'succeeded',
              durationMs: 0,
            }),
          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('schedules a transient failure and succeeds on retry', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        let currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z');
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          {
            kind: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'processing_error',
            retryable: true,
          },
          { kind: 'succeeded' },
        ]);
        const clock: Clock = { now: () => new Date(currentTime) };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          clock,
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          () => 0,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'pending',
          attemptCount: 1,
          nextAttemptAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z',
          version: 3,
        });
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(false);
    
        currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z');
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(true);
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'succeeded',
          attemptCount: 2,
          version: 5,
        });
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_retry_scheduled',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              nextAttemptAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z',
            }),
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_completed',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 2,
            }),
          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('fails immediately after a permanent provider decline', async () => {
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          {
            kind: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'provider_declined',
            retryable: false,
          },
        ]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'provider_declined',
          attemptCount: 1,
        });
      });
    
      it('retries unknown errors and fails after attempts are exhausted', async () => {
        let currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z');
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          new Error('temporary provider error'),
          new Error('provider still unavailable'),
        ]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date(currentTime) },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, maxAttempts: 2 },
          () => 0,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
        currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z');
        await worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'attempts_exhausted',
          attemptCount: 2,
        });
      });
    
      it('times out a provider that never settles', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: () => new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>(() => undefined),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, attemptTimeoutMs: 100, maxAttempts: 1 },
        );
    
        const processing = worker.processNextPayment();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100);
        await processing;
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'processing_timeout',
          attemptCount: 1,
        });
      });
    
      it('does not overwrite an operator update with a late gateway result', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        let resolveGateway: ((result: PaymentGatewayResult) => void) | undefined;
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: () =>
            new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>((resolve) => {
              resolveGateway = resolve;
            }),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          undefined,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
        const processing = worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await vi.waitFor(async () => {
          expect(
            (await repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id))?.status,
          ).toBe('processing');
        });
        const claimed = await repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id);
        expect(claimed).toBeDefined();
        if (claimed === undefined) {
          throw new Error('Expected a claimed payment');
        }
    
        await repository.updatePayment(
          {
            ...claimed,
            status: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator',
            updatedAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:01.000Z',
            version: claimed.version + 1,
          },
          claimed.version,
        );
        resolveGateway?.({ kind: 'succeeded' });
        await processing;
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator',
          version: 3,
        });
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_worker_result_discarded',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              reason: 'version_conflict',
            }),
          ]),
        );
        expect(
          logs.entries().some((entry) => entry.event === 'payment_completed'),
        ).toBe(false);
      });
    
      it('correlates persistence failures without recording raw provider errors', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        vi.spyOn(repository, 'updatePayment').mockRejectedValue(
          new Error('storage-secret'),
        );
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          new ScriptedPaymentGateway([new Error('provider-secret')]),
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          () => 0,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
    
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).rejects.toThrow('storage-secret');
        expect(logs.text()).not.toContain('-secret');
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_gateway_error',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              level: 40,
            }),
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_persistence_failed',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              level: 50,
            }),
          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('polls without overlapping and can be stopped', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'succeeded' }]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
        );
    
        worker.start();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
        await worker.stop();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded' });
        expect(gateway.contexts).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    
      it('aborts active gateway work after the shutdown deadline', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        let attemptSignal: AbortSignal | undefined;
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: (_payment, context) => {
            attemptSignal = context.signal;
            return new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>((_resolve, reject) => {
              context.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
                reject(new Error('gateway attempt aborted'));
              });
            });
          },
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, shutdownTimeoutMs: 100 },
        );
        worker.start();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
    
        const stopping = worker.stop();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100);
    
        await expect(stopping).resolves.toBe(false);
        expect(attemptSignal?.aborted).toBe(true);
        await expect(worker.stop()).resolves.toBe(true);
      });
    });

## Assistant

The review found two worker gaps: a lease that is still active at restart is never checked again, and an aborted gateway attempt can schedule a retry after shutdown has timed out. I’ll fix both and add regression tests. The full suite still hits `EPERM` on socket binding, and the audit cannot reach the registry.

    import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
    import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
    import { join } from 'node:path';
    
    import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
    
    import { createApp } from '../../src/app.js';
    import { loadConfig } from '../../src/config/index.js';
    import { writeFileAtomically } from '../../src/infrastructure/storage/atomic-file-writer.js';
    import { PaymentService } from '../../src/modules/payments/payment.service.js';
    import { PaymentWorker } from '../../src/modules/payments/payment.worker.js';
    import type { PaymentGatewayResult } from '../../src/modules/payments/payment-gateway.types.js';
    import { JsonPaymentRepository } from '../../src/modules/payments/repositories/json-payment.repository.js';
    import { UuidGenerator } from '../../src/shared/helpers/id-generator.js';
    import { requestApp } from '../helpers/request-app.js';
    import { ScriptedPaymentGateway } from '../helpers/scripted-payment-gateway.js';
    
    describe('HTTP-to-storage payment lifecycle', () => {
      let directory: string;
      beforeEach(async () => { directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'payment-lifecycle-')); });
      afterEach(async () => { await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }); });
    
      async function setup(failCreates = false) {
        let rejectWrites = false;
        const config = loadConfig({ PAYMENT_DATA_FILE: join(directory, 'payments.json') });
        const repository = new JsonPaymentRepository({ filePath: config.dataFilePath, writeFileAtomically: async (path, contents) => {
          if (rejectWrites) throw new Error('simulated disk failure');
          await writeFileAtomically(path, contents);
        } });
        await repository.initialize();
        rejectWrites = failCreates;
        let now = new Date('2026-11-13T12:00:00.000Z');
        const clock = { now: () => new Date(now) };
        const service = new PaymentService(repository, clock, new UuidGenerator());
        const app = createApp({ config, paymentService: service });
        const create = () => requestApp(app, '/payments', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': 'lifecycle-key' }, body: { amount: 2500, currency: 'NGN' } });
        return { app, create, config, repository, clock, advance: (ms: number) => { now = new Date(now.getTime() + ms); }, allowWrites: () => { rejectWrites = false; } };
      }
    
      it('returns before gateway completion and preserves an operator win over a late worker result', async () => {
        const { app, create, config, repository, clock } = await setup();
        const created = await create();
        expect(created.status).toBe(202);
        const payment = JSON.parse(created.body) as { id: string; status: string };
        expect(payment.status).toBe('pending');
        const entered = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
        const result = Promise.withResolvers<PaymentGatewayResult>();
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(repository, { processPayment: () => { entered.resolve(); return result.promise; } }, clock, config.worker);
        const processing = worker.processNextPayment();
        await entered.promise;
        try {
          const current = await requestApp(app, `/payments/${payment.id}`);
          const claimed = JSON.parse(current.body) as { status: string; version: number };
          expect(claimed.status).toBe('processing');
          const updated = await requestApp(app, `/payments/${payment.id}/status`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { status: 'failed', expectedVersion: claimed.version, failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator' } });
          expect(updated.status).toBe(200);
        } finally {
          result.resolve({ kind: 'succeeded' });
          await processing;
        }
        const final = await requestApp(app, `/payments/${payment.id}`);
        expect(JSON.parse(final.body) as unknown).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator', version: 3 });
      });
    
      it('serializes simultaneous duplicate creates into one durable payment', async () => {
        const { create, repository } = await setup();
        const responses = await Promise.all([create(), create()]);
        expect(responses.map((response) => response.status).sort()).toEqual([200, 202]);
        const payments = responses.map((response) => JSON.parse(response.body) as { id: string });
        expect(payments[0]?.id).toBe(payments[1]?.id);
        const record = await repository.findIdempotencyRecordByKey('lifecycle-key');
        expect(record?.paymentId).toBe(payments[0]?.id);
      });
    
      it('does not consume an idempotency key after a failed create write', async () => {
        const { create, repository, allowWrites } = await setup(true);
        const failed = await create();
        expect(failed.status).toBe(500);
        expect(failed.body).not.toContain('simulated disk failure');
        await expect(repository.findIdempotencyRecordByKey('lifecycle-key')).resolves.toBeUndefined();
        allowWrites();
        expect((await create()).status).toBe(202);
      });
    
      it('resumes persisted pending retries in a new repository instance', async () => {
        const { create, repository, config, clock, advance } = await setup();
        const payment = JSON.parse((await create()).body) as { id: string };
        const first = new PaymentWorker(repository, new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'failed', failureCode: 'processing_error', retryable: true }]), clock, config.worker, () => 0);
        await first.processNextPayment();
        const restarted = new JsonPaymentRepository({ filePath: config.dataFilePath });
        await restarted.initialize();
        advance(config.worker.retryBaseDelayMs);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(restarted, new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'succeeded' }]), clock, config.worker);
        await worker.processNextPayment();
        await expect(restarted.findPaymentById(payment.id)).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', attemptCount: 2 });
      });
    
      it.each(['{ invalid json', JSON.stringify({ amount: 2500, currency: 'NGN', reference: 'x'.repeat(17000) })])('maps malformed or oversized HTTP bodies to safe errors', async (rawBody) => {
        const { app } = await setup();
        const response = await requestApp(app, '/payments', { method: 'POST', rawBody, headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': 'invalid-body-key' } });
        expect(response.status).toBe(rawBody.startsWith('{ invalid') ? 400 : 413);
        expect(JSON.parse(response.body) as unknown).toMatchObject({ error: { path: '/payments' } });
      });
    });

    import { mkdtemp, readFile, readdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
    import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
    import { join } from 'node:path';
    
    import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
    
    const { rename } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ rename: vi.fn() }));
    vi.mock('node:fs/promises', async (importOriginal) => ({ ...await importOriginal<typeof import('node:fs/promises')>(), rename }));
    
    import { writeFileAtomically } from '../../src/infrastructure/storage/atomic-file-writer.js';
    
    describe('atomic file failure', () => {
      let directory: string | undefined;
      afterEach(async () => {
        if (directory !== undefined) await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
      });
    
      it('preserves the old snapshot and removes the temporary file when rename fails', async () => {
        directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'atomic-file-failure-'));
        const path = join(directory, 'payments.json');
        await writeFile(path, '{"snapshot":"original"}\n');
        rename.mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('simulated rename failure'));
        await expect(writeFileAtomically(path, '{"snapshot":"next"}\n')).rejects.toThrow('simulated rename failure');
        expect(await readFile(path, 'utf8')).toBe('{"snapshot":"original"}\n');
        expect(await readdir(directory)).toEqual(['payments.json']);
      });
    });

    describe('startService', () => {

        const events: string[] = [];

        const started = startService({
          initializeStorage: async () => {
            events.push('initialize');
            await initializing.promise;
          },
          recoverWork: async () => {
            events.push('recover');
          },
          worker: {
            start: () => {
              events.push('worker');

          },

            events.push('listen');
            return 'listening';
          },
        });
        expect(events).toEqual(['initialize']);
        initializing.resolve();
        await expect(started).resolves.toBe('listening');
        expect(events).toEqual(['initialize', 'recover', 'worker', 'listen']);

                if (stage === 'initialize') throw new Error('storage unavailable');

    import type {
      PaymentGateway,
      PaymentGatewayResult,
    } from './payment-gateway.types.js';
    import type { PaymentRepository } from './payment-repository.types.js';
    import {
      GatewayAttemptAbortedError,
      GatewayAttemptTimeoutError,
    } from './payment-worker.errors.js';
    import type { PaymentWorkerOptions } from './payment-worker.types.js';
    import { assertPaymentTransitionAllowed } from './payment.state-machine.js';
    import type { Payment, PaymentFailureCode } from './payment.types.js';
    import type { Clock } from '../../shared/types/clock.types.js';
    import type { ServiceLogger } from '../../shared/types/logger.types.js';
    
    export class PaymentWorker {
      private activeAttemptController: AbortController | undefined;
      private activePoll: Promise<void> | undefined;
      private pollTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
      private running = false;
      private stopping = false;
    
      constructor(
        private readonly repository: PaymentRepository,
        private readonly gateway: PaymentGateway,
        private readonly clock: Clock,
        private readonly options: PaymentWorkerOptions,
        private readonly random: () => number = Math.random,
        private readonly reportError: (error: unknown) => void = () => undefined,
        private readonly logger?: ServiceLogger,
      ) {}
    
      start(): void {
        if (this.running) {
          return;
        }
    
        this.running = true;
        this.stopping = false;
        this.schedulePoll(0);
      }
    
      async stop(): Promise<boolean> {
        this.running = false;
        this.stopping = true;
    
        if (this.pollTimer !== undefined) {
          clearTimeout(this.pollTimer);
          this.pollTimer = undefined;
        }
    
        const activePoll = this.activePoll;
        if (activePoll === undefined) {
          return true;
        }
    
        let shutdownTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        const stoppedGracefully = await Promise.race([
          activePoll.then(() => true),
          new Promise<false>((resolve) => {
            shutdownTimer = setTimeout(
              () => resolve(false),
              this.options.shutdownTimeoutMs,
            );
          }),
        ]);
    
        if (shutdownTimer !== undefined) {
          clearTimeout(shutdownTimer);
        }
    
        if (!stoppedGracefully) {
          this.activeAttemptController?.abort();
        }
    
        return stoppedGracefully;
      }
    
      async processNextPayment(): Promise<boolean> {
        if (this.stopping) return false;
        const recoveredPayments = await this.repository.recoverExpiredPayments(
          this.clock.now(),
          this.options.leaseMs,
          this.options.maxAttempts,
        );
        if (recoveredPayments > 0)
          this.logger?.info(
            { event: 'payment_leases_recovered', recoveredPayments },
            'Expired payment leases recovered',
          );
        if (this.stopping) return false;
        const claimedPayment = await this.repository.claimNextDuePayment(
          this.clock.now(),
        );
    
        if (claimedPayment === undefined || this.stopping) {
          return false;
        }
    
        this.logger?.info(
          {
            event: 'payment_attempt_started',
            paymentId: claimedPayment.id,
            attemptCount: claimedPayment.attemptCount,
            version: claimedPayment.version,
          },
          'Payment attempt started',
        );
    
        let result: PaymentGatewayResult;
    
        try {
          result = await this.processWithTimeout(claimedPayment);
        } catch (error) {
          if (this.stopping || error instanceof GatewayAttemptAbortedError) {
            this.logger?.warn(
              {
                event: 'payment_attempt_interrupted',
                paymentId: claimedPayment.id,
                attemptCount: claimedPayment.attemptCount,
              },
              'Interrupted payment retained for lease recovery',
            );
            return true;
          }
          this.logger?.warn(
            {
              event: 'payment_gateway_error',
              paymentId: claimedPayment.id,
              attemptCount: claimedPayment.attemptCount,
        };
      }
    
      recoverExpiredPayments(
        now: Date,
        leaseMs: number,
        maxAttempts: number,
      ): DocumentMutation<number> {
        const document = this.document;
        const nowIso = now.toISOString();
        const leaseCutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - leaseMs).toISOString();
        let recoveredCount = 0;
        const payments = Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(document.payments).map(([id, payment]) => {
            if (
              payment.status !== 'processing' ||
              payment.processingStartedAt === undefined ||
              payment.processingStartedAt > leaseCutoff
            ) {
              return [id, payment];
            }
    
            recoveredCount += 1;
            const exhausted = payment.attemptCount >= maxAttempts;
            const recoveredPayment: Payment = {
              id: payment.id,
              amount: payment.amount,
              currency: payment.currency,
              ...(payment.reference === undefined
                ? {}
                : { reference: payment.reference }),
              status: exhausted ? 'failed' : 'pending',
              attemptCount: payment.attemptCount,
              ...(exhausted
                ? { failureCode: 'attempts_exhausted' as const }
                : { nextAttemptAt: nowIso }),
              createdAt: payment.createdAt,
              updatedAt: nowIso,
              version: payment.version + 1,
            };
            return [id, recoveredPayment];
          }),
        );
    
        if (recoveredCount === 0) {
          return { document, result: 0 };
        }
    
        return {
          document: { ...document, payments },
          result: recoveredCount,
        };
      }
    }

    # Payment Processing Service
    
    A small, production-minded payment-processing microservice designed for a Node.js + React Developer assessment. It exposes an Express REST API for creating payments, retrieving them, and updating their status while processing new payments asynchronously.
    
    > **Project status:** implementation milestones 1–9 are complete, including the API contract and operating guide. Final delivery verification and polish remain in Task 10.
    
    ## What this project demonstrates
    
    The default repository stores a versioned document such as:
    
    ```json
    {
      "schemaVersion": 1,
      "payments": {},
      "idempotencyRecords": {}
    }
    ```
    
    Persistence behavior:
    
    1. Load and validate the complete file at startup.
    2. Refuse readiness/startup on malformed JSON or an unsupported schema version; do not silently erase it.
    3. Serialize all mutations through one in-process write queue.
    4. Apply a mutation to an in-memory snapshot, write the complete next snapshot to a temporary file in the same directory, flush it, then atomically rename it over the data file.
    5. Publish the new in-memory snapshot only after the durable write succeeds.
    6. Surface write failures to the request/worker and log them with context.
    
    The file is excluded from Git. The data directory is created on startup. Tests use an isolated temporary directory or an in-memory repository implementing the same interface.
    
    **Why:** writing directly to the destination risks truncated JSON after a crash. Atomic replacement plus serialized mutations is compact and adequate for one process. A repository boundary preserves a clean migration path to PostgreSQL, where unique idempotency keys and row versions would enforce the same invariants.
    
    ## 8. Asynchronous processing, retries, and recovery
    
    The worker starts after repository initialization and stops accepting work during graceful shutdown.
    
    - It polls for due `pending` payments at a modest configurable interval (for example, 250 ms).

    `app.ts` constructs the Express application without listening on a port, which allows Supertest to exercise it directly. `server.ts` is the composition root and owns startup, listening, worker lifecycle, and graceful shutdown.
    
    Payment-specific behavior and its repository implementations stay in `modules/payments`. File-database mechanics, storage schemas, and atomic writing stay under `infrastructure/storage`, mirroring the separation between database infrastructure and feature repositories in a database-backed service. Other cross-module adapters, such as the simulated provider and Pino configuration, also stay under `infrastructure`. Cross-cutting Express functions live under `middleware`.
    
    The runtime JSON directory is intentionally absent from the committed tree. The service creates the parent directory of the configured data-file path, such as `./data/payments.json`, and `.gitignore` excludes the generated data.

    -- Graceful shutdown stops polling and waits for an active attempt only up to a bounded deadline. If it cannot finish, lease recovery handles it on restart.
    +- On startup and before each claim, a `processing` payment with an expired lease is requeued if attempts remain, or failed with `attempts_exhausted`. Still-active leases are rechecked on later polls, covering quick restarts and completion write failures without requiring another restart. Interrupted claims consume attempts.
    +- Graceful shutdown stops polling and waits for an active attempt only up to a bounded deadline. At the deadline the attempt is aborted and its persisted claim retained for recovery; no retry is written during the abort path. The gateway must release its own resources on cancellation. Already-running native filesystem operations cannot be cancelled by this deadline.

    ## Regression coverage added during final review
    
    - HTTP creation returns a persisted pending payment before delayed provider completion.
    - Concurrent identical requests create one durable payment and replay the winner.
    - Failed create writes do not consume the idempotency key; subsequent retry can succeed.
    - Operator finalization wins against a late worker completion.
    - Persisted pending retries resume in a new repository instance.
    - A quick restart leaves an active lease alone until it expires, then polling recovers it.
    - A completion write failure retains the durable processing claim and recovers after the lease.
    - Exhausted abandoned work fails without another provider call.
    - Malformed/oversized HTTP bodies return sanitized, path-aware errors.
    - Rename failure preserves the previous file and cleans up the temporary file.
    - Invalid persisted state is rejected without overwriting the storage file.
    - Prototype-named idempotency keys, including `__proto__`, survive reload and replay.
    - Startup initializes storage and recovers work before worker/listener startup; listener failure stops the worker.
    - Shutdown stops claims, aborts even a non-cooperative gateway wait, retains interrupted work, and clears worker timers.
    - Forced HTTP closure reports a timeout even when the close callback fires synchronously.
    - Polling survives an error reporter that throws.
    
    The HTTP lifecycle integration tests use actual Express middleware/controllers with Node request/response streams in memory. They complement the Supertest suite; they do not verify TCP listening, actual OS signal delivery, or browser rendering of the CDN-based Swagger UI.
    
    ## Required local or CI verification
    
    From a clean checkout, with registry access and permission to listen on local ports:
    
    ```bash
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
    pnpm format:check
    pnpm lint
    pnpm typecheck
    pnpm test
    pnpm build
    pnpm audit --audit-level=high
    ```
    
    Then run `pnpm start`, visit `/health`, `/health/ready`, `/doc`, and `/openapi.json`, exercise the README payment examples, and stop with `Ctrl+C` to verify real process shutdown. Swagger UI assets require browser internet access. Review any audit findings rather than assuming success from this sandbox run. Keep the single-process JSON-storage deployment constraint.

Why is this method catch not handled in payment.worker.ts?

## Assistant

The outer `catch` handles processing failures by calling `reportError(error)`. The inner `catch` handles the case where that reporting callback also throws.

It was added to keep a broken reporter from rejecting the polling promise and producing an unhandled rejection through `poll.finally(...)`.

But your concern is valid: the empty inner catch makes the reporting failure invisible. It preserves polling, but loses observability.

A better approach here is to use the injected logger directly for poll failures and remove the separate `reportError` callback. We currently have two mechanisms for reporting errors—the callback and the logger—which adds unnecessary complexity.

    import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
    
    import type {
      PaymentGateway,
      PaymentGatewayResult,
    } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/payment-gateway.types.js';
    import { PaymentWorker } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/payment.worker.js';
    import { InMemoryPaymentRepository } from '../../../../src/modules/payments/repositories/in-memory-payment.repository.js';
    import type { Clock } from '../../../../src/shared/types/clock.types.js';
    import {
      buildIdempotencyRecord,
      buildPayment,
    } from '../../../helpers/payment-fixtures.js';
    import { ScriptedPaymentGateway } from '../../../helpers/scripted-payment-gateway.js';
    import { captureLogs } from '../../../helpers/capture-logs.js';
    
    const defaultWorkerOptions = {
      attemptTimeoutMs: 1_000,
      leaseMs: 30_000,
      maxAttempts: 3,
      pollIntervalMs: 250,
      retryBaseDelayMs: 250,
      shutdownTimeoutMs: 500,
    } as const;
    
    async function createSeededRepository(): Promise<InMemoryPaymentRepository> {
      const repository = new InMemoryPaymentRepository();
      await repository.initialize();
      await repository.createPayment(buildPayment(), buildIdempotencyRecord());
      return repository;
    }
    
    describe('PaymentWorker', () => {
      afterEach(() => {
        vi.useRealTimers();
      });
    
      it('claims and completes a successful payment', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'succeeded' }]);
        const clock: Clock = {
          now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z'),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          clock,
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          () => 0,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
    
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(true);
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'succeeded',
          attemptCount: 1,
          version: 3,
        });
        expect(gateway.contexts[0]?.idempotencyKey).toBe(buildPayment().id);
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_attempt_started',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 1,
            }),
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_completed',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 1,
              status: 'succeeded',
              durationMs: 0,
            }),
          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('schedules a transient failure and succeeds on retry', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        let currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z');
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          {
            kind: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'processing_error',
            retryable: true,
          },
          { kind: 'succeeded' },
        ]);
        const clock: Clock = { now: () => new Date(currentTime) };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          clock,
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          () => 0,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'pending',
          attemptCount: 1,
          nextAttemptAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z',
          version: 3,
        });
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(false);
    
        currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z');
        await expect(worker.processNextPayment()).resolves.toBe(true);
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'succeeded',
          attemptCount: 2,
          version: 5,
        });
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_retry_scheduled',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              nextAttemptAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z',
            }),
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_completed',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              attemptCount: 2,
            }),
          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('fails immediately after a permanent provider decline', async () => {
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          {
            kind: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'provider_declined',
            retryable: false,
          },
        ]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'provider_declined',
          attemptCount: 1,
        });
      });
    
      it('retries unknown errors and fails after attempts are exhausted', async () => {
        let currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z');
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([
          new Error('temporary provider error'),
          new Error('provider still unavailable'),
        ]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date(currentTime) },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, maxAttempts: 2 },
          () => 0,
        );
    
        await worker.processNextPayment();
        currentTime = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.250Z');
        await worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'attempts_exhausted',
          attemptCount: 2,
        });
      });
    
      it('times out a provider that never settles', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: () => new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>(() => undefined),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, attemptTimeoutMs: 100, maxAttempts: 1 },
        );
    
        const processing = worker.processNextPayment();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100);
        await processing;
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'processing_timeout',
          attemptCount: 1,
        });
      });
    
      it('does not overwrite an operator update with a late gateway result', async () => {
        const logs = captureLogs();
        const enteredGateway = Promise.withResolvers<void>();
        let resolveGateway: ((result: PaymentGatewayResult) => void) | undefined;
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: () =>
            new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>((resolve) => {
              resolveGateway = resolve;
              enteredGateway.resolve();
            }),
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
          undefined,
          undefined,
          logs.logger,
        );
        const processing = worker.processNextPayment();
    
        await enteredGateway.promise;
        const claimed = await repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id);
        expect(claimed).toBeDefined();
        if (claimed === undefined) {
          throw new Error('Expected a claimed payment');
        }
    
        await repository.updatePayment(
          {
            ...claimed,
            status: 'failed',
            failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator',
            updatedAt: '2026-11-13T12:01:01.000Z',
            version: claimed.version + 1,
          },
          claimed.version,
        );
        resolveGateway?.({ kind: 'succeeded' });
        await processing;
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({
          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'cancelled_by_operator',
          version: 3,
        });
        expect(logs.entries()).toEqual(
          expect.arrayContaining([
            expect.objectContaining({
              event: 'payment_worker_result_discarded',
              paymentId: buildPayment().id,
              reason: 'version_conflict',
            }),
          ]),
        );
        expect(
          logs.entries().some((entry) => entry.event === 'payment_completed'),
        ).toBe(false);
      });

            expect.objectContaining({

          ]),
        );
      });
    
      it('polls without overlapping and can be stopped', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([{ kind: 'succeeded' }]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          defaultWorkerOptions,
        );
    
        worker.start();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
        await worker.stop();
    
        await expect(
          repository.findPaymentById(buildPayment().id),
        ).resolves.toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded' });
        expect(gateway.contexts).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    
      it('aborts active gateway work after the shutdown deadline', async () => {
        vi.useFakeTimers();
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        let attemptSignal: AbortSignal | undefined;
        const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
          processPayment: (_payment, context) => {
            attemptSignal = context.signal;
            return new Promise<PaymentGatewayResult>((_resolve, reject) => {
              context.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
                reject(new Error('gateway attempt aborted'));
              });
            });
          },
        };
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z') },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, shutdownTimeoutMs: 100 },
        );
        worker.start();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(0);
    
        const stopping = worker.stop();
        await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(100);
    
        await expect(stopping).resolves.toBe(false);
        expect(attemptSignal?.aborted).toBe(true);
        await expect(worker.stop()).resolves.toBe(true);
      });
    
      it('recovers a lease that expires after a quick restart without exceeding the attempt limit', async () => {
        const repository = await createSeededRepository();
        const start = new Date('2026-11-13T12:01:00.000Z');

        const gateway = new ScriptedPaymentGateway([]);
        const worker = new PaymentWorker(
          repository,
          gateway,
          { now: () => now },
          { ...defaultWorkerOptions, maxAttempts: 1 },

        expect(await worker.processNextPayment()).toBe(false);
        now = new Date(start.getTime() + defaultWorkerOptions.leaseMs);

        await expect(

          status: 'failed',
          failureCode: 'attempts_exhausted',
          attemptCount: 1,

        expect(gateway.contexts).toHaveLength(0);
      });

    import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
    import { open, rename, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
    import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path';
    
    export async function writeFileAtomically(
      filePath: string,
      contents: string,
    ): Promise<void> {
      const temporaryPath = join(
        dirname(filePath),
        `.${basename(filePath)}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`,
      );
    
      try {
        const handle = await open(temporaryPath, 'wx', 0o600);
    
        try {
          await handle.writeFile(contents, { encoding: 'utf8' });
          await handle.sync();
        } finally {
          await handle.close();
        }
    
        await rename(temporaryPath, filePath);
      } catch (error) {
        await rm(temporaryPath, { force: true }).catch(() => undefined);
        throw error;
      }
    }

    export async function closeHttpServer(
      server: CloseableHttpServer,
      timeoutMs: number,
    ): Promise<boolean> {
      return new Promise<boolean>((resolve, reject) => {
        let settled = false;
        const settle = (result: boolean, error?: unknown): void => {
          if (settled) {
            return;
          }
    
          settled = true;
          clearTimeout(timeout);
    
          if (error === undefined) {
            resolve(result);
          } else {
            reject(
              error instanceof Error
                ? error
                : new Error('HTTP server shutdown failed', { cause: error }),
            );
          }
        };
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
          settle(false);
          server.closeAllConnections?.();
        }, timeoutMs);
    
        try {
          server.close((error) => {
            settle(true, error);
          });
          server.closeIdleConnections?.();
        } catch (error) {
          settle(false, error);
        }
      });
    }

    export function serializeError(error: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
      if (!(error instanceof Error)) {

      return {

          .join('\n'),

    }

    import { JsonPaymentRepository } from './modules/payments/repositories/json-payment.repository.js';
    import { closeHttpServer, startService } from './server-lifecycle.js';

    const config = loadConfig();
    const logger = createLogger(config.logLevel);
    const clock = new SystemClock();

          'HTTP request failed',
        );
      },
    });
    
    async function start(): Promise<void> {
      const server = await startService({
        initializeStorage: () => repository.initialize(),
        recoverWork: async () => {
          const recoveredPayments = await repository.recoverExpiredPayments(
            clock.now(),
            config.worker.leaseMs,
            config.worker.maxAttempts,
          );
          logger.info(
            { event: 'payment_leases_recovered', recoveredPayments },
            'Expired payment leases recovered',
          );
        },
        worker,
        listen: async () => {
          const server = app.listen(config.port);
          await once(server, 'listening');
          return server;
        },
      });
    
      ready = true;
      logger.info(
        { event: 'service_started', port: config.port },
        'Payment service started',
      );
      installShutdownHandlers(server);
    }
    
    function installShutdownHandlers(server: Server): void {
      let shutdown: Promise<void> | undefined;
    
      const handleSignal = (signal: NodeJS.Signals): void => {
        shutdown ??= stop(server, signal);
      };
    
      process.once('SIGTERM', handleSignal);
      process.once('SIGINT', handleSignal);
    }
    
    async function stop(server: Server, signal: NodeJS.Signals): Promise<void> {
      ready = false;
      logger.info(
        { event: 'service_stopping', signal },
        'Payment service stopping',
      );
    
      const [httpResult, workerResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
        closeHttpServer(server, config.worker.shutdownTimeoutMs),
        worker.stop(),
      ]);
    
      if (httpResult.status === 'rejected') {
        process.exitCode = 1;
        logger.error({ err: httpResult.reason }, 'HTTP server shutdown failed');
      } else if (!httpResult.value) {
        logger.warn('HTTP connections exceeded the shutdown deadline');
      }
    
      if (workerResult.status === 'rejected') {
        process.exitCode = 1;
        logger.error({ err: workerResult.reason }, 'Worker shutdown failed');
      } else if (!workerResult.value) {
        logger.warn('Active payment work exceeded the shutdown deadline');
      }
    
      logger.info({ event: 'service_stopped' }, 'Payment service stopped');
      logger.flush();
    }

      process.exitCode = 1;
      logger.fatal(
        { event: 'service_startup_failed', err: error },
        'Payment service failed to start',

    export async function writeFileAtomically(
      filePath: string,
      contents: string,
      logger?: ServiceLogger,
    ): Promise<void> {
      const temporaryPath = join(
        dirname(filePath),
        `.${basename(filePath)}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`,
      );
    
      try {
        const handle = await open(temporaryPath, 'wx', 0o600);
    
        try {
          await handle.writeFile(contents, { encoding: 'utf8' });
          await handle.sync();
        } catch (error) {
          try {
            await handle.close();
          } catch (closeError) {
            (logger ?? createLogger('info')).error(
              { event: 'storage_file_close_failed', err: closeError, filePath },
              'Failed to close temporary storage file after a write failure',
            );
          }
          throw error;
        }
        await handle.close();
    
        await rename(temporaryPath, filePath);
      } catch (error) {
        try {
          await rm(temporaryPath, { force: true });
        } catch (cleanupError) {
          (logger ?? createLogger('info')).error(
            {
              event: 'storage_cleanup_failed',
              err: cleanupError,
              filePath,
              temporaryPath,
            },
            'Failed to remove temporary storage file',
          );
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }
